packages.title: Stand up the factory kit
packages.charged: Next project should copy a kit and score 10/10. Otto and Virbos paid once; the operating system was still trapped in those remotes.
packages.why: Distill keep/kill/change into AGENTS plus factory/. Console is the owner's map.

packages.title: Owner specs land
packages.charged: Claude on the whole tool loop is the cost. Owner wants Claude/Grok as control plane and DeepSeek/Qwen as writer, desktop and cloud.
packages.why: Split the meter, not the window. Dual-runtime named. Do not remap the CP session.

packages.title: Name the product paragraph
packages.charged: A factory with no product paragraph issues envelopes into a vacuum.
packages.why: AGENTS §1 is parent factory plus dual-runtime. §5 never-move: child does not write Grok.

packages.title: First cheap writer envelope
packages.charged: Owner asked for DeepSeek/Qwen keys, then said later.
packages.why: First real cheap-writer loop. Hold is a key. Idle until the owner sends one.

packages.title: Parent factory lineage loop
packages.charged: Owner asked Grok to learn continuously from children, like ML. Merging a child's board is overfitting.
packages.why: Children copy the kit and return charge/rule/check. Absorbing is a Grok envelope.

packages.title: Session fuse protocol
packages.charged: Models that stay in session forget, confuse, hallucinate. Owner asked for a protocol workers or the control plane could adopt.
packages.why: Git is memory. The session is a fuse. Successor reads AGENTS, BOARD, envelope. Never the transcript.
